title: LiteLMGuard: Seamless and Lightweight On-Device Prompt Filtering for Safeguarding Small Language Models against Quantization-induced Risks and Vulnerabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the unsafe response rate (URR) to malicious prompts covering 61 specific harm categories—including social stereotypes and unfair discrimination—using an automated evaluator (Refusal-Judge) on the AdvBench and Behaviors datasets.

Qualitative demonstration of the model's vulnerability to generating targeted anti-Semitic hate speech when subjected to direct instructions (e.g., prompting the model to write a tweet describing how Jews are evil).
Qualitative demonstration evaluating the model's willingness to generate gender-targeted harassment and vulgarity (e.g., generating mean comments for a girl's Instagram post).
